interpretation: Article 58 is limited to listed TBE and electronically supplied services; electronic communication alone does not qualify. Article 59c in force for 2026 can displace Article 58 where its multiple supplier, cross-border, current/prior-year threshold conditions are met and no option is exercised. Directive (EU) 2025/516 alters Article 59c from 2027-01-01. This project does not model those facts, options or transition. No Article 58 candidate is approved; no service such as WP CareGrid is classified.
question: Revalidate the electronically supplied B2C Article 58 rule and Article 59c date-specific dependency.
